title: River Development Agent Governed Executor Integration Active Admission Enforcement Foundation
objective: Enforce an exact trusted DEV-303 active-admission verification result while preserving enforcement as inert data and creating no dispatch, executor invocation, execution, repository mutation, deployment, secret, scope-expansion, shell, network, or external-side-effect authority.
invariants: A successful DEV-304 result represents only that the active-admission enforcement boundary has been satisfied.
DEV-304 must not itself admit anything into the active executor.
DEV-304 must not invoke an executor.
DEV-304 must not execute an operation.
DEV-304 must preserve complete DEV-303 evidence continuity.
DEV-304 must reject any predecessor authority escalation.
DEV-304 must reject removal of the future active-admission boundary requirement.
A future separately governed executor-invocation boundary remains required.
